0.original: You feel the call of the road, but when a mishap strikes, Nazyl Duzyl has one more call on your time.

1.original: One of a pair of researchers excavating a lakeside site has fallen down a hole. Nazyl Duzyl bids you head west and deliver a length of thick rope to the wrought researcher that awaits assistance for his learned colleague.

2.original: Once given the rope, the researcher trades his anxiety for resoluteness. He orders you to leave the rescue to him and take an urgent message to Kakamehi in Revenant's Toll: send medicines.

3.original: Having delivered the message to Kakamehi, your work is done. Kakamehi is dispatching the potions and liniments even as you settle in for a well-earned rest. Another day, another job well done.

24.original: Give the rope to the wrought researcher.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, how fortunate to have you here! One of the researchers excavating the lakeside has tumbled down a hole!

49.original: He remains there still and has wounds that will need tending, but his team traveled quite light. They lack the necessary supplies for his rescue.

50.original: Will you take this length of rope to the lakeside, for the rescue?

51.original: After that, you must hasten to Revenant's Toll and tell Kakamehi to dispatch medicines thither.

52.original: We are already much in your debt, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, if not in gil then in spirit─but may I impose on you one last time?

53.original: Hallo! Thank the Twelve you're here! He fell right down this hole, thinks he broke a leg.

54.original: We have to get him out before he passes out again─the pain seems to be bad. Have you any rope?

55.original: Good and stout! Right, I can fish him out by myself here. But once he's out, he'll need some true physicking.

56.original: Go on to Revenant's Toll and tell them to send potions─buckets of them!

57.original: I'll fish him out by myself. You go on to Revenant's Toll and tell them to send potions.

58.original: Long time no see, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! They keeping you busy at Saint Coinach's Find? Ah, an accident, eh? Not enough physick, sure, sure.

59.original: I'll get what's needed to the Sons. You look like you ran all the way─go sun those soles, you've earned a rest.
